subject: POC plan + risk tracker / Stellar Commerce
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Turner <sam.turner@stellar-commerce.com>, Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@stellar-commerce.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recap & next steps from today's discovery / POC planning

Thanks for the call today — appreciate the context on your search & the sample workload. Below is a short recap and proposed next steps so we can get the POC stood up next week. Please flag anything I missed.

Quick recap
- Goal: evaluate Redwood for low-latency, cost-predictable inference for Stellar's checkout & personalization use cases (real-time recommendations + cart summarization).
- Success criteria (proposed):
  - 95th percentile latency < 200ms for single-turn queries at expected 100 qps baseline
  - End-to-end cost estimate within 20% of current batch inference spend
  - No regression on core accuracy metrics on your reference prompts (we'll run the eval set you shared)

Proposed POC plan (attached: poc_evaluation_plan_v1.xlsx)
- Timeline: 3 weeks (Week 0: infra + data prep; Week 1: model tuning & baseline runs; Week 2: stress tests + evals)
- Owners:
  - Redwood: Marissa (program lead), Dev (integration/infra), Rachel (SRE liaison)
  - Stellar: Sam (product lead), Alicia (eng lead)
- Deliverables: working endpoint(s) + evaluation report + cost/latency dashboard

Risks / known unknowns (we'll track in the risk tracker):
- Data access delays for the eval set (mitigation: use anonymized staging set; Sam to confirm by Fri)
- Potential blocking bug on auth flow for token exchange (Dev to validate by integration test day)

Next steps
1) Sam/Alicia: confirm success criteria and sign-off on timeline by Thu, Oct 1
2) Redwood: share Drive folder & initial poc_evaluation_plan_v1.xlsx (attached) — owners assigned inside the sheet
3) Schedule kickoff: propose Mon, Oct 4 10am PT (15 min) for infra handoff

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

—
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: poc_evaluation_plan_v1.xlsx

From: Sam Turner <sam.turner@stellar-commerce.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@stellar-commerce.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 30 Sep 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap & next steps from today's discovery / POC planning

Thanks Marissa — this looks good. A few quick confirmations from our side:
- Success criteria: agree to the latency and cost bands you proposed; we'll add an accuracy threshold (F1 >= 0.78 on the reference set) and we'll send the eval prompts by end of day Friday.
- Timeline: Oct 4 kickoff works for our infra team.
- Data: we'll provide a masked subset of the production prompts (approx. 5k examples) by Friday. If that slips we'll fallback to a synthetic set.

One risk to call out: our security team requires a minimal evidence pack (SOC2 + network diagram + data retention policy) before we spin up the endpoint in our VPC. Alicia, can you own coordinating that?

Sam
Product Manager | Stellar Commerce
sam.turner@stellar-commerce.com | +1 (212) 555-0199

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@stellar-commerce.com>, Sam Turner <sam.turner@stellar-commerce.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 01 Oct 2026 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap & next steps from today's discovery / POC planning

Appreciate the quick confirmation. We'll prepare the evidence pack — Neha I'll loop you in to share SOC2 summary + retention docs.

Alicia / Sam: to keep the POC moving while your security review runs, plan below to isolate risk areas:
- Use a staging VPC with restricted network egress (Dev will provide template)
- Limit data to masked subset only (Sam to confirm delivery timeline)
- If the evidence pack isn't approved by kickoff, we can still run a non-prod demo on Redwood-hosted environment with synthetic data (no access to Stellar PII)

I'll also create a lightweight risk tracker in the Drive folder and tag initial owners. If we hit a blocking issue, we propose this escalation path:
1) Dev Patel (Redwood) — primary triage
2) Rachel Kim (Redwood SRE) — infra escalation
3) Marissa Cole — customer escalation & exec loop-in

Will confirm kickoff calendar invite once Sam confirms data delivery.

—
Marissa

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sam Turner <sam.turner@stellar-commerce.com>, Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@stellar-commerce.com>
Date: Fri, 01 Oct 2026 15:36:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap & next steps from today's discovery / POC planning

Quick update from infra prep:
- Integrated the initial auth flow with Stellar's staging OAuth — during smoke tests we hit a token refresh race that caused 401s under concurrent requests. Repro steps and short trace attached (error_trace_20261001.tar.gz).
- Impact: blocks reliable high-concurrency latency runs.
- Mitigation: temporary retry on 401 with backoff + pin single refresh token endpoint behind a mutex. I estimate a 1-2 day fix to implement a robust refresh queue.
- Escalation: if we can't stabilize by Oct 6, we should escalate to Rachel for an infra-side load test and to Marissa for customer communication.

I'll start the retry patch today and post PR. Rachel, can you run an isolated load test on the staging VPC once the patch is up?

—
Dev
Senior Engineer, Platform Integrations | Redwood Inference

From: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@stellar-commerce.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Sam Turner <sam.turner@stellar-commerce.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 07 Oct 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap & next steps from today's discovery / POC planning

Thanks for the transparency — the token refresh race is helpful context. A couple asks from Stellar Security/Eng:
- Please confirm the escalation SLA: we need an initial triage within 4 business hours for P0s and daily status updates until resolution.
- Can you add an exec contact (VP-level) to the escalation list after Marissa? We'll need someone who can commit cross-team resources if needed.
- Please share the mitigation ETA and the PR link when available so our engs can review in parallel.

If the ETA looks like >48 hours, we'll want to pause the concurrency portion of the POC and proceed with functional/accuracy runs in parallel.

Thanks — Alicia
Director of Engineering | Stellar Commerce
